title: Create VerdictDot interactive button component
description:
Create `dashboard/frontend/components/editor/VerdictDot.tsx` — a button component replacing the existing static `fv-verdict-dot` spans.

Props: `status` ('pass'|'warn'|'fail'), `selected` (boolean), `compareSelected` (boolean), `isLatest` (boolean), `onClick` (callback), `onShiftClick` (callback), `tooltip` (string), `tabIndex` (number).

Rendering rules:
- Render as `<button>` with class `fv-verdict-dot` preserved for styling continuity.
- Size: 6px default, 8px when `selected`, `compareSelected`, or `isLatest`.
- Color: map status to `--color-emerald` / `--color-amber` / `--color-red`.
- Opacity: 1.0 for latest/selected/compareSelected, 0.5 otherwise. Hover: 0.8.
- Selection ring: `box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-border)` when `selected`. `box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-accent)` when `compareSelected`. Compare ring hover adds `--color-accent-glow` shadow.
- Hit area: pad the `<button>` to at least 24x24px with the visual dot centered.
- Pressed state: `transform: scale(0.9)`.
- Focus: `outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent)` with 2px offset.
- Tooltip: native `title` attribute set to `tooltip` prop.
- Click handler: check `event.shiftKey` — if true, call `onShiftClick`; otherwise call `onClick`.

Accessibility:
- `aria-label="Audit run from {tooltip}, verdict: {status}"`. When selected, append ", selected".
- `aria-pressed={selected || compareSelected}`.
- `tabIndex` prop passed through for roving tabindex (caller controls).

Motion: `transition: opacity 120ms ease-out, transform 120ms ease-out, box-shadow 120ms ease-out`. Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, set `transition: none`.

Export the component as default and as named export `VerdictDot`.
acceptance_criteria:
- [test] VerdictDot renders a <button> element with class fv-verdict-dot
- [test] aria-label includes relative timestamp and verdict status
- [test] aria-pressed reflects selected or compareSelected state
- [test] Click with shiftKey=true calls onShiftClick, not onClick
- [test] Click without shiftKey calls onClick, not onShiftClick
- [manual] Selected dot shows box-shadow ring using --color-border
- [manual] Compare-selected dot shows box-shadow ring using --color-accent
- [manual] Button hit area is at least 24x24px via padding
- [manual] prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables all transitions
- [lint] No hardcoded color values — all colors reference CSS custom properties
